purpose: Release-level index for Voice v2.2. Detailed setup and steps stay in the component suites referenced below; this matrix maps the release requirements without duplicating those scenarios.

component_suites.role: cross-feature state, transcript policy, Direct Conversation, interruption, and event privacy
full, brief, silent, Test Voice, TTS availability, and provider registry
Web Speech capability and confirm-send input fallback
Local ASR configuration, local transport, cleanup, packaged runtime, and process exit

requirements.1: Normal typed chat is unaffected by Voice settings.
requirements.2: Voice Output off does not auto-speak.
requirements.3: Test Voice can be explicitly triggered.

automated_test_refs: App > sends chat and renders user plus assistant messages
App > does not speak assistant replies when Voice Output is disabled
App > plays a test voice from Settings without writing chat
App > stops active speech from the Stop Voice control

requirements.5: Local ASR unconfigured state fails safely.
requirements.6: Normal voice mode waits for confirmation.
requirements.7: Direct Conversation auto-sends after an explicit recording round.

automated_test_refs: App > shows Local ASR not configured status in Voice Input settings
App > fills final Voice Input transcript into the input without auto sending
App > auto sends a Local ASR transcript in Direct Conversation Mode without leaking the transcript to Event Stream
App > defaults Direct Conversation Mode off and persists explicit opt-in

requirements.12: Likely partial transcript is not auto-sent.
requirements.13: Guarded input does not write memory.
requirements.14: Guarded input does not trigger proactive behavior.

automated_test_refs: App > keeps empty Direct Conversation Local ASR transcripts out of chat and Event Stream text
App > blocks short Web Speech transcripts from auto sending in Direct Conversation Mode
App > blocks short Local ASR recordings from auto sending in Direct Conversation Mode
App > blocks likely partial transcripts from Direct Conversation auto-send

requirements.15: assistant_thinking begins only after a confirmed or direct send.
requirements.17: Stop enters visible interrupted or stopped feedback.

automated_test_refs: App > enters assistant_thinking only after a ready voice transcript is confirmed
App > auto speaks direct conversation replies when Voice Output is enabled and can stop playback
App > stops active Voice Output when Voice Input starts

requirements.18: TTS unavailable keeps the text reply.
requirements.19: full profile speaks the sanitized full reply.
requirements.20: brief profile uses deterministic limits without another LLM call.
requirements.21: silent profile keeps text and does not speak.

automated_test_refs: App > does not crash and shows a readable status when local TTS is unavailable
voice profile policy > allows full assistant replies in normal chat
voice profile policy > uses brief mode by default for direct conversation replies
voice profile policy > skips speech in silent mode

requirements.22: System Speech Synthesis is the only selectable provider.
requirements.23: Local TTS and External TTS are disabled placeholders.
requirements.24: Invalid or disabled provider ids safely fall back or no-op.

automated_test_refs: ttsProviderRegistry > keeps only the system provider enabled and selectable
ttsProviderRegistry > reserves local and external providers as disabled future metadata
ttsProviderRegistry > falls back safely when an illegal provider id is requested
VoiceOutputController provider resolution > reports system provider unavailable without calling speech synthesis

requirements.25: Event Stream does not retain a full transcript.
requirements.26: Event Stream does not retain a full assistant reply.
requirements.27: Event Stream does not retain spoken text.
requirements.28: Event Stream does not retain raw prompt, environment files, credentials, authorization data, or local paths.

automated_test_refs: App > auto sends a Local ASR transcript in Direct Conversation Mode without leaking the transcript to Event Stream
App > fills final Voice Input transcript into the input without auto sending
App > keeps full direct conversation text visible while speaking only the brief excerpt
App > shows TTS lifecycle summaries without full assistant text in Event Stream

requirements.29: Exiting the packaged app leaves no bundled backend process.
requirements.30: Voice workspace, Settings, Debug, and normal chat have no obvious UI regression.
